categories.name: Things that dim the blue sky

fun_fact: Blue skies are beautiful. They make everything better. But increasingly, polluted air has meant that our skies now look like a hazy shade of grey rather than an azure blue. Today (Sept 7) is celebrated as the International Day of Blue Skies. Hope this makes you smile: [100 days of blue skies](https://photos.google.com/share/AF1QipPyYubIyF__2vAi7NAcoD3eQVTmgs7w-2GXA8XZd6QkkWjqY04BVLAOSmqexqgqZA?key=TzFDV2NMTXBmM2dmc0JaQnJtZGZzcGRwNjJURzhB) and reminds you of what we stand to lose if we don't fix our air pollution soon!
author: Sailee
